fusions.name: Creeping Scree
fusions.desc: After a 2-second rumble, a slide of scree crosses a cone 5 tiles long and deals 30 earth damage to everything in it. It ignores armour and leaves everything hit [Slowed] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Weathering Blow
fusions.desc: A grinding blow that deals 4 damage and leaves the target 8% easier to wound for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Older Than Hills
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 30% for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Silt Settles
fusions.desc: Your armour rises by 10%, and you regenerate 1 health a second.
